gemini.performance_metric: net premiums earned grew to $2,722.6M in 2020
gemini.rationale: The slice reports that Allied World continued to operate as a named reportable segment with net premiums earned growing to $2,722.6 million in 2020 and stable goodwill of ~$940 million, indicating no realized product/process disruption (p4=0). Furthermore, there is no documented evidence of process/organization fracture or cultural clashes, as the parent company continued to invest capital to support underwriting plans and the business operated stably (p5=0).

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; assets retained/grew to ~$17.0bn; goodwill stable ~$940M
grok.rationale: The FY2020 parent segment disclosure shows Allied World still operating as a global P&C and specialty insurer/reinsurer with net premiums earned rising to $2,722.6M and segment assets to $16,975.5M, with allocated goodwill essentially stable at ~$940M and no product-line or operating-process incoherence reported, so p4_pathway=0. No fracture at the process/organization interface is documented either (management continuity is explicitly unverified; redomestication to Bermuda and capital contribution to support underwriting are recorded without cultural or operational-integration failure), so p5_pathway=0.
